content.text: We’ve got links to (re)watch, matchcards, storylines, and a brief history of WWE’s biggest event of the yearYou don’t need to watch WWE every week to know WrestleMania is a big deal. This is the event people mark on their calendars. Legacies are cemented, careers are transformed, and the future of WWE is shaped under the brightest lights. WrestleMania 42 took over Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Saturday, April 18, 2026, and Sunday, April 19, 2026. Read on for more info about WrestleMania weekend and how to watch. And when you’re finished reading below, check out our article on WWE Legends, covering the movies and shows featuring wrestling Superstars.Watch The WrestleMania 42 Teaser0:35WrestleMania 42 Is Now Streaming: Here’s Everything You Need To Know About This Year’s EventHow to watch WrestleMania 42?If you missed WrestleMania 42 or just want to re-live the action, both nights are available to watch in the ESPN App with ESPN Unlimited and on Disney+ with a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle.*Add WrestleMania 42 (Night 1) to WatchlistAdd WrestleMania 42 (Night 2) to WatchlistWhat time did WrestleMania 42 start?WrestleMania 42, ESPN, WWEBoth nights of WrestleMania 42 began at 6pm ET / 3pm PT.How long is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 is a two-night event with no official runtime. This isn’t the kind of event you casually squeeze in before bed. Based on past events, you’re looking at four to five hours each night.Where is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 took over Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.What is the WrestleMania 42 pre-show?Think of it like the pregame show before the action gets underway. Every WWE Premium Live Event gets a live pre-show and post-show, and this one started at 3pm ET / 12pm PT on both days.Who was wrestling at WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42, ESPN, WWEThere were a number of major title matches at WrestleMania 42. CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship, Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE Championship, Stephanie Vaquer vs. Liv Morgan for the Women’s World Championship, and Jade Cargill vs. Rhea Ripley for the WWE Women’s Championship. We also had AJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch for the Women’s Intercontinental Championship, and a clash of behemoths with Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar. What were the big storylines during WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42, ESPN, WWECM Punk vs. Roman ReignsThis one is personal, and no one is trying to hide it. Reigns won the 2026 Royal Rumble, and got into an intense war of words with Punk. By the end of their standoff, Reigns told Punk he had always hated him and that he would challenge him on The Grandest Stage of Them All. That is more than enough to carry a WrestleMania main event.Stephanie Vaquer vs. Liv MorganLiv Morgan earned this title shot by winning the Royal Rumble, and choosing Vaquer as her opponent. Since then, the feud escalated quickly. Bad blood like this usually makes for an epic WrestleMania title showdown.Cody Rhodes vs. Randy OrtonRhodes and Orton share a storied history, having fought side by side in The Legacy and maintaining a close friendship throughout the years. The whole story hangs on one very simple idea: Orton only needs a second to hit an RKO and become a 15-time World Champion.Jade Cargill vs. Rhea RipleyIt’s a power clash for the WWE Women’s Championship. Cargill comes in as the reigning champion, with Ripley earning the title shot by winning the Elimination Chamber. It’s a matchup we’ve never seen before, and it looks huge on paper.Oba Femi vs. Brock LesnarHas Brock Lesnar met his match? Lesnar called out WWE Superstars to his Open Challenge for WrestleMania 42, and Oba Femi answered. This is sure to be an epic collision that you’re not going to want to miss.All WrestleMania 42 Match CardsWrestleMania 42 Night One (Saturday, April 18) MatchesUndisputed WWE Championship Match: Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton (with Pat McAfee)Women's World Championship Match: Stephanie Vaquer (c) vs. Liv MorganSeth Rollins vs. GuntherWomen’s Intercontinental Championship Match: AJ Lee (c) vs. Becky LynchWWE Women’s Tag Team Championship Fatal 4-Way Match: Nia Jax and Lash Legend (c) vs. Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria vs. The Bella Twins Unsanctioned Match: Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob FatuSix-Man Tag Team Match: Logan Paul, Austin Theory, and IShowSpeed vs. The Usos and LA KnightWrestleMania 42 Night Two (Sunday, April 19) MatchesWorld Heavyweight Championship Match: CM Punk (c) vs. Roman ReignsWWE Women's Championship Match: Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea Ripley"The Demon" Finn Bálor vs. Dominik MysterioUnited States Championship Match: Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick WilliamsOba Femi vs. Brock LesnarIntercontinental Championship Ladder Match: Penta (c) vs. Je’Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey MysterioAdd WrestleMania 42 (Night 1) to WatchlistAdd WrestleMania 42 (Night 2) to WatchlistWrestleMania History & LegacyWhat is WrestleMania and why does it matter?WrestleMania is WWE’s biggest event of the year. It’s the ultimate stage where rivalries conclude, championships are decided, and unforgettable moments happen. The first WrestleMania transformed wrestling into mainstream entertainment, pulling in celebrities like Mr. T, Cyndi Lauper, Muhammad Ali, and Liberace. The event’s grand scale is why WrestleMania is the pinnacle of wrestling entertainment today. When was the first WrestleMania?The first WrestleMania took place on March 31, 1985 at Madison Square Garden in New York. Tito Santana won the first match by beating The Executioner.Who won at WrestleMania 41?John Cena beat Cody Rhodes to win the Undisputed WWE Championship in the main event of WrestleMania 41, giving him a record 17th world title.Check out our Sports Spotlight for even more articles covering topics like this!*WWE WrestleMania requires plan that includes ESPN Unlimited.Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle: U.S. residents, 18+ only.
